statements.proposition: This change makes no breaking changes to the public API of browser-use.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Checked in the diff: library code is only added (24, 13 and 4 added lines, 0 deleted, in agent/service.py, controller/service.py and controller/views.py), with no removed or renamed public name and no changed signature. Only the example script is rewritten. Residual risk: wait_for_user_input is registered by default and the system prompts now mention it, so an LLM could call it and end run() early. That is new behaviour, not a removed or changed interface, so it is not counted as breaking here. Not run.
